answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 365 aliases needs 365 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The vertex of the seal is the chip, the ember of the quote is the receipt, and the terrace of the heartbeat proves a live device, not a script.
